sentences.text: The fossilized upper arm bone measures 110 cm in length, while the ulna reaches 69 cm.
Unlike other titanosaurs, this animal lacked an olecranon and its first metacarpal was not bowed.
The species name adamastor honors a mythological sea monster representing dangers faced by Portuguese sailors in the southern Atlantic.
It holds the distinction of being the first named dinosaur from Angola.
Angolatitan is the first non-avian dinosaur discovered in Angola.
Octávio Mateus found the fossil on May 25 near Iembe in the Bengo province.
The genus was formally described by Octávio Mateus and colleagues in 2011.
Scientists believe this sauropod was well adapted to arid environments, much like modern desert elephants.
Recent phylogenetic tests classify Angolatitan as a non-titanosaurian titanosauriform.
Angolatitan was a basal titanosauriform living during the Late Cretaceous, a time when more derived titanosaurs were dominant.
The ecosystem inhabited by Angolatitan was likely desert-like.
It lived approximately 90 million years ago during the mid-Cretaceous in what is now Africa.
The animal lived between 89.8 and 85.7 million years ago during the Coniacian stage.
